title: Lens Replacement Overdue Alert
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lens:replacement days_overdue=* replacement_type=*
| where days_overdue>0
| sort - days_overdue
| table replacement_type days_worn days_overdue replacement_status
description: Flags contact lens replacements worn past their scheduled change date.
value: Overworn lenses increase infection risk and discomfort that a simple overdue view prevents.
implementation: Log `days_worn` and scheduled replacement dates on each lens change and alert on positive overdue days.
visualization: Table of overdue replacements by type.
grandmaExplanation: It counts contact lenses you have been wearing longer than you should have.
